about: The Sign of the Cross joins the gesture of the cross to a brief invocation of the Holy Trinity.

s01.translation: In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit. Amen.

translation_citations.title: Francis X. Lasance, The Catholic Girl's Guide (1906)

w007.explanation: “Spíritus” can be nominative or genitive. The following “Sancti” (w008) establishes the genitive here: “of the Holy Ghost”.
